args.subject: Private Dining Request – Table for 12 on Friday, May 24, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request a private dining table for 12 guests at New Asiaway on Friday, May 24, 2024.

Reservation details:
- Restaurant: New Asiaway, 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France
- Date: Friday, May 24, 2024
- Party size: 12
- Preferred seating: Evening service (the restaurant is open 12:00 PM - 3:00 PM and 6:00 PM - 10:00 PM on Fridays). We are flexible on the exact time and would also be glad to be considered for lunch.

Could you please confirm whether a private dining table is available, along with the confirmed time, and let me know of any menu requirements, minimum spend, or deposit needed to secure the booking?

My contact details:
- Name: Emma Johnson
- Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
- Phone: 327-420-4923

Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
